decisions.reason: Recording campaign leads in a Google Sheet before CRM transfer does not change the configured HubSpot lead-management properties, stages, lists, notes, or task assignment.
The import workflow does not change whether email and LinkedIn communication histories are visible in HubSpot.
The Google Sheet staging step does not change the deferred Contact Source funnel reporting requirement or its reporting fields.
The source establishes a lead-transfer workflow but does not change the selected HubSpot platform, Starter subscription, or CRM use.
Staging leads in a Google Sheet before CRM transfer does not alter synchronization of MeetAlfred reply status into HubSpot.
The source concerns initial tracking of campaign leads in CRM, not movement of silent leads into follow-up lists or MeetAlfred campaigns.
The intermediate Google Sheet does not necessarily change the required type of LinkedIn profile URL stored for a lead.
The source describes transferring leads into CRM, whereas this candidate governs the separate outbound transfer of HubSpot lists to MeetAlfred.
The stated import workflow does not modify restrictions on using production or genuine leads for integration testing.
The Google Sheet-to-CRM workflow does not change MeetAlfred configuration requirements or its subscription plan.
Tracking leads before CRM import does not alter the procedure for provisioning a new MeetAlfred campaign and its Zap.
The source does not change the channel, automation mode, platform, or deferred status of the automated email campaign.
